scenario: The office Wi-Fi is down and nobody can work. They have been sitting in silence for twenty minutes. Alex has been staring at his phone; Den has been refreshing the same page again and again. Pol says: 'We haven't talked to each other without screens for a long time.' So they start talking. Alex asks Valery about his life, and Valery says he has been collecting stamps for thirty years. Den has been learning to cook lately. When the Wi-Fi finally comes back, nobody rushes to their laptops — they keep talking. Warm and a little thoughtful. Use present perfect continuous (have/has been + verb-ing, 'for/since') a lot. Level B1, so sentences can be a bit longer.
